content.title: Pokémon Champions is expected to release on mobile devices in June - IG News
content.text: Pokémon Champions is expected to release on mobile devices in June - IG NewsPokémon Champions is expected to release on mobile devices in JuneApril 7, 2026 2:44 PM, by ThibautPokémon Champions will be released on Switch this Wednesday, April 8. This somewhat unique installment will focus exclusively on Pokémon battles within an arena. In addition to the Switch version, the game is also set to be released on mobile devices. However, no release date had been announced for this version until now. That was until a South Korean website dedicated to the franchise briefly listed June 2026 as the release window for Pokémon Champions on iOS and Android. It remains to be seen whether this will be confirmed soon.
